intents.title: Carry the ledger tree forward
intents.statement: Every ledger commit carries the previous tree forward and adds one event, so turn records, baselines and the expected tree are readable from the tip instead of only the latest event.

intents.title: Record turns and the expected tree
intents.statement: Turn begin records the turn, its baseline and E := C; turn ready and turn commit record the updated turn and merge the touched post-hashes into state/expected.json in the same ledger commit.

intents.title: Compact one turn record per turn
intents.statement: The projection writes one file per turn. The ledger stores full touched and implements maps every twentieth event and a since/add/remove delta otherwise, and expands the delta when reading.

intents.title: Repair the projection from the ledger
intents.statement: afwe repair regenerates .afwe/turns from the ledger, reproduces the YAML byte for byte, and moves only proven duplicate files to .afwe/backups. It refuses when the ledger has no turn records, so an incomplete ledger never wipes the projection.

intents.title: Move the ledger between clones
intents.statement: afwe ledger push and fetch use an explicit ledger refspec. A fetch fast-forwards when possible, and a divergence writes a forked event carrying both tips without merging or rewriting either chain. Bootstrap imports the tracked projection once as provenance=imported.

intents.title: Document the ledger, repair and transport
intents.statement: The README, tutorial, spec, skill and ubiquitous language describe the ledger ref, schema version, expected tree, compaction, repair, bootstrap, push/fetch and the fork rule.
